name: Deploy USSD API

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ussd-api-production
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Deploy USSD API to VPS
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - name: Validate configuration
        env:
          VPS_HOST: ${{ secrets.VPS_HOST }}
          VPS_USER: ${{ secrets.VPS_USER }}
          VPS_SSH_KEY: ${{ secrets.VPS_SSH_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -eu

          if [ -z "$VPS_HOST" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: VPS_HOST is missing"
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ -z "$VPS_USER" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: VPS_USER is missing"
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ -z "$VPS_SSH_KEY" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: VPS_SSH_KEY is missing"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "USSD API deployment configuration OK"

      - name: Configure SSH
        env:
          VPS_HOST: ${{ secrets.VPS_HOST }}
          VPS_SSH_KEY: ${{ secrets.VPS_SSH_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -eu

          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          chmod 700 ~/.ssh

          printf '%s\n' "$VPS_SSH_KEY" \
            > ~/.ssh/ussd_api_key
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/ussd_api_key

          ssh-keyscan \
            -p 22 \
            -H "$VPS_HOST" \
            >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts

          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/known_hosts

      - name: Test SSH connection
        env:
          VPS_HOST: ${{ secrets.VPS_HOST }}
          VPS_USER: ${{ secrets.VPS_USER }}
        run: |
          set -eu

          ssh \
            -i ~/.ssh/ussd_api_key \
            -p 22 \
            -o BatchMode=yes \
            -o ConnectTimeout=10 \
            "$VPS_USER@$VPS_HOST" \
            "echo 'SSH connection to USSD API VPS successful'"

      - name: Deploy USSD API
        env:
          VPS_HOST: ${{ secrets.VPS_HOST }}
          VPS_USER: ${{ secrets.VPS_USER }}
        run: |
          set -eu

          ssh \
            -i ~/.ssh/ussd_api_key \
            -p 22 \
            -o BatchMode=yes \
            -o ConnectTimeout=10 \
            -o ServerAliveInterval=30 \
            -o ServerAliveCountMax=10 \
            "$VPS_USER@$VPS_HOST" \
            "sudo -n /usr/local/bin/deploy-ussd-api"
